title: Siri AI could come with a paywall for power users | TechCrunch
summary: In his final earnings call as CEO of Apple, Tim Cook said that the company’s long-awaited Siri AI upgrade could come with some paywalled limits. Amanda Silberling is a senior writer at TechCrunch covering the intersection of technology and culture.
